versions.content: The function Gpt_DisableNotification shall disable the interrupt notification of the refe renced channel configured for notification (see also Specification of GPT Driver AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 41 of 68 Document ID 30 : AUTOSAR_SWS_GPTDriver - AUTOSAR confidential - SWS_Gpt_00233 ). The function shall save an attribute like "notification disabled" of the channel.
